purpose: Publication table for six system-level analyses in which the frozen evidence does not license a stronger downstream state/context inference. 'Unreachable' means unreachable under the frozen evidence and analysis contract, not biologically impossible.
selection_rule: Include system-level branches with a locked negative, failed-adequacy, not-identifiable, or representation-collapse outcome that blocks a stronger downstream interpretation. Exclude Oenothera harringtonii because its frozen result positively identifies a missing contemporary coordinate. Keep the cross-origin identifiability STOP as a separate synthesis-level boundary rather than a seventh system row.

systems.numeric_certificate: held-out MSE 1.08774 for the partial state versus 1.13209 with mainland distance; 4.08% worsening; improvement at 3/8 held-out sites
systems.unreachable_stronger_inference: The locked partial state is complete, or mainland distance is biologically irrelevant.
systems.blocking_reason: A negative residual-context result is conditional on the supplied state and cannot certify completeness or irrelevance.

systems.numeric_certificate: 0/6 fixed reproductive endpoints met the preregistered positive residual-context rule under garden holdout
systems.unreachable_stronger_inference: The interaction state is complete, or local/urban context is biologically irrelevant.
systems.blocking_reason: Failure to obtain reproducible residual gain does not identify the supplied state as sufficient.

systems.numeric_certificate: adding urban cover and green-space edge density worsened held-out NLL by 4932.9195; garden-bootstrap 95% interval [603.9654, 10953.6611]
systems.unreachable_stronger_inference: The partial pollination/floral state is complete, or urban context is biologically irrelevant.
systems.blocking_reason: A held-out residual-context non-gain is not evidence that all response-relevant state coordinates were measured.

systems.numeric_certificate: exact metadata gate detected 'Fallow ground' versus 'Fallow graound'; the prospectively allowed one-key sensitivity found the mismatch at a second array and stopped before primary seed-function model fitting
systems.unreachable_stronger_inference: The preregistered pollinator proxy is an adequate seed-function state, or residual habitat/context effects can be interpreted after it.
systems.blocking_reason: The primary endpoint/proxy mapping is not identifiable under the frozen metadata contract; downstream residual modelling would manufacture a repaired state after outcome inspection.

systems.numeric_certificate: leave-one-orchard-out fruit-production gains -0.10195 [-3.12202, 3.61919] and -0.09919 [-3.14415, 3.66453] for the two deposited pollinator-abundance representations
systems.unreachable_stronger_inference: Pollinator abundance is an endpoint-relevant state coordinate, or residual landscape/local-management context can be interpreted after it.
systems.blocking_reason: Neither mandatory deposited process representation earned held-out measurement adequacy, so the residual-context gate was not opened.

systems.numeric_certificate: after feature-wise standardisation, effective-transfer and phase-visitation coordinates differed by at most 8.88e-16; no fixed interaction representation beat the mean baseline in 23-population leave-one-population-out prediction
systems.unreachable_stronger_inference: The richer effective-transfer state was analytically supplied as a distinct coordinate, or residual context can be interpreted after that supposedly richer state.
systems.blocking_reason: Preprocessing projected the richer biological measurement onto the simpler visitation coordinate, so the claimed mechanistic distinction was not preserved for downstream inference.

excluded_positive_system.reason: Its frozen result is not an unreachable branch: maternal spatial isolation reduced held-out MSE from 0.11619 to 0.09187 (20.93% improvement; locked permutation p=0.00130), positively identifying a missing contemporary coordinate.

separate_synthesis_boundary.reason: Origin is confounded with study, taxa, protocol, biological coordinate and response construction; this is a synthesis-level STOP, not one of the six system rows.
